step_by_step_approach: Determine the first term start year for each legislator.
Check whether each legislator is serving on December 31 of the start year (0 years).
Check whether each legislator is serving on December 31 of the year two years after the start year.
Check whether each legislator is serving on December 31 of the year four years after the start year.
Check whether each legislator is serving on December 31 of the year six years after the start year.
Check whether each legislator is serving on December 31 of the year eight years after the start year.
Check whether each legislator is serving on December 31 of the year ten years after the start year.
For each state and gender, calculate the proportion of legislators retained at the start year.
For each state and gender, calculate the proportion of legislators retained at year two.
For each state and gender, calculate the proportion of legislators retained at year four.
For each state and gender, calculate the proportion of legislators retained at year six.
For each state and gender, calculate the proportion of legislators retained at year eight.
For each state and gender, calculate the proportion of legislators retained at year ten.
Keep only those state‑gender groups where all six proportions are greater than zero.
Select states where both male and female groups satisfy the non‑zero condition for all six years.
Return the abbreviations of those states.
